{"metadata":{"description":"Developer tool: live token usage & cost monitoring for DeepSeek Harness - consumed tokens for the current session and across all sessions, read from token-meter projections. No model calls.","id":"gh:1333928947","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-token-viewer","slug":"qwert702/dsh-token-viewer","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","observability","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Developer tool: live token usage & cost monitoring for DeepSeek Harness - consumed tokens for the cu"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rrent session and across all sessions, read from token-meter projections. No model calls."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-token-viewer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI**. Read-only surface"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"s over the harness's host-computed projections plus one balance read; the plugin adds no prompt cont"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ent, tools, or provider requests."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Install (one command):**
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Restart the harness, refresh the web page, then click the **Token** icon in the sidebar panel list"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"; the account balance also shows up as a chip at the bottom of the sidebar."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Targets harness **0.2.0-rc.2** (and 0.1.6+ — slot names, projection APIs, and service contracts are "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"unchanged between those releases; **v0.3.0** switches to the loader-applied plugin `Config` export, "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"the sanctioned config channel since the settings service became `SettingsForms`). Earlier versions o"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"f this plugin disabled the official `ui-sidebar` plugin and forked its `sidebar.workspaces.header` s"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"lot; that slot is gone in 0.1.6, so **v0.2.1 and later no longer override any official plugin** — it"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" registers into the stock slots instead. On an older harness, pin v0.2.0. **v0.4.2** re-verified on "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"the 0.2.0-rc.2 dependency tree: `node test/smoke.cjs` and 48 component tests (vitest, 5 specs) pass,"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" and `node scripts/build-client.mjs` rebuilds `lib/` byte-identically."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Sidebar panel** — a **Token** row in the sidebar's global panel list; clicking it opens the plug"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"in's page in the main area: DeepSeek account balance (with refresh; error-retry when the host proxy "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"fails) and aggregate consumption across all sessions, expandable to a per-conversation list.
- **Bal"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ance chip** — the sidebar footer carries the live account balance (full amount when the sidebar is w"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ide, a bare currency mark on the collapsed rail); clicking it opens the statistics drawer.
- **Whale"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"-maid pet** — a bottom-right pet showing the active pricing tier: asleep with a moon badge and risin"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"g Z's through the off-peak windows, awake with a lightning badge through the Beijing peak windows. T"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"he tooltip shows the tier, the countdown to the next window boundary, and the currently applicable f"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"lash prices; clicking the pet opens the statistics drawer, and the pet tucks itself away while the d"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"rawer is open.
- **TokenDock** — a slim live strip above the composer showing the current session's "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"billed input (uncached + cache read + cache write), output, cache hit rate, and approximate context "},{"id":"p8s12","text":"occupancy.
- **Usage statistics panel** (drawer in `shell.overlay`, a faithful port of CC Switch's u"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"sage-dashboard method):
- **Per-request statistics** — the host `usageLog` projection records one ti"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"mestamped entry per reported assistant step (commit time, model, four token buckets); every figure f"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"olds these records, never cumulative session totals. The projection retains the newest 10,000 entrie"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"s per session (stateVersion 2), so long-lived sessions stop growing the fold and the wire payload at"},{"id":"p8s17","text":" that point.
- **Hero** — real consumption (fresh input + output + cache write + cache read), reques"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"t count, total cost, over a five-card breakdown row with a cache-hit-rate progress bar.
- **Trend ch"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"art** — requests bucketed by their own commit time (hourly for the day, daily otherwise, empty bucke"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"ts zero-filled), four token series plus a dashed cost line.
- **Three tabs** — request log (newest f"},{"id":"p8s21","text":"irst; clicking a row opens that session), per-project statistics, and per-model statistics with aver"},{"id":"p8s22","text":"ow opens that session), per-project statistics, and per-model statistics with average cost.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Slot layout"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Six registrations, all in stock slots (see `src/client/index.ts`):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Slot | Surface | Id |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `sidebar.panellist` | panel row + icon | `token` |
| `main` | panel page (its `key` must equal the"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" row's `id`) | `token` |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | balance chip | `token-viewer-balance` |
| `conv"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ersation.input.dock` | live token strip | `token-viewer` |
| `shell.overlay` | statistics drawer | `"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"token-viewer-detail` |
| `shell.overlay` | whale-maid pet | `token-viewer-pet` |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Repo layout"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- `src/index.ts` — host half source (balance + pricing routes, `modelUsage` / `usageLog` session pro"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"jections, all with `wire` views so the browser can read them). **`src` is the single source of truth"},{"id":"p15s3","text":".**
- `src/client/**` — browser half source: the five slot entries above, their components, and thei"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"r CSS Modules.
- `lib/index.js`, `lib/client.js` — the built artifacts the harness actually loads. C"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ommitted on purpose so `dsh plugin add` works with no build step.
- `scripts/build-client.mjs` — `no"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"de scripts/build-client.mjs`: esbuild builds both halves (`src/index.ts` → `lib/index.js`, `src/clie"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"nt/index.ts` → `lib/client.js`). `react` and the harness's other static browser modules stay externa"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"l; `.module.css` goes through a small built-in CSS Modules plugin that scopes class names and inject"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"s a `<style data-plugin data-plugin-css>` tag at materialization.
- `test/smoke.cjs` — `node test/sm"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"oke.cjs`: harness-free smoke test. It stubs `window.__ModuleLoader__` in a `vm` sandbox, runs `apply"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"()` against a recording slot registry, renders every component against a stub kit, and imports the h"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"rding slot registry, renders every component against a stub kit, and imports the host half for real."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The TypeScript monorepo source (extracted from `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`) lives on the `archive"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"/monorepo-src` branch."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Model pricing"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`PRICING_FALLBACK` in `src/index.ts` (built into `lib/index.js`) holds the current DeepSeek list pri"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ces; the panel fetches `GET /api/billing/pricing`, which prefers the provider's official pricing pag"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e when reachable and falls back to the built-in table otherwise. The statistics drawer installs the "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"route's rows as its active billing table and re-folds its costs when they land; the browser carries "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"the same rows as `MODEL_PRICING_FALLBACK` in `src/client/derive.ts`, so an unreachable route degrade"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"s to the same prices instead of inventing any. The per-session list and the composer dock keep billi"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"ng at the flash off-peak floor — those figures are aggregate estimates without per-request times."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"MIT, **except** `src/client/assets/whale-maid.png` (embedded into `lib/client.js`): the community's "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"chibi DeepSeek whale-maid, from yefeng7531/dsh-whale-maid-mascot, originally published at bilibili o"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"pus/1231977657712771073, licensed **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** (non-commercial use only, share-alike; only re"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"scaled to 135×240). See `src/client/assets/SOURCE.md`."}],"truncated":true}
